jobs.desc: Infosys is hiring Digital Specialist Engineers (Trainee) to design, develop, test, validate and support digital solutions. The listing is for eligible 2024–2026 UG/PG graduates with up to two years of experience.
jobs.elig: 2024, 2025 or 2026 UG/PG graduates; B.E./B.Tech in any specialization, M.Tech, MCA or MS/M.Sc. (Science); up to 2 years of experience. Confirm the full requirements on the listing before applying.
resp: Design, develop, validate and support digital solutions.
Review requirements and contribute to design, development and testing.
Prepare and review code, documentation and unit test scripts.
Support go-live activities and help resolve production issues.
jobs.sourceVerificationMethod: Exact Naukri Infosys job listing opened and checked on 30 Oct 2026; title, employer, locations, experience, eligibility, compensation and active Apply button were visible.
jobs.who: UG/PG graduates from 2024, 2025 or 2026 with up to two years of experience, a listed eligible degree and programming skills.
